events.title: Demo is Out !
events.summary: The demo is finally available!Get ready to dive into the woolly madness and discover a preview of the chaos awaiting you. Please note that the demo content is limited:10 minigames availableNo cosmetics, only basic colorsNo coin rewards or cosmetic unlocksSteam achievements disabledThe demo will remain available until the official Early Access release in 2026.If you encounter bugs, issues, or would like to help improve the game, feel free to join the Discord server or share your feedback directly
